fields.Front: ES2240F: give the full grade breakdown with weights and dates.
fields.Back:
Quizzes 10% (9 offered, complete 7; missing ones = zero)
Report Part 1 (intro + reference list) 10%, Oct 6, 1:00 pm
Final report (2500 words) 30%, Dec 1, 1:00 pm
Midterm 20%, Oct 24, 2 h online with Proctortrack, Units 1-2 to end of Ch 9
Final exam 30%, 2 h, non-cumulative, Unit 3 intro to Ch 20

fields.Front: How many ES2240F quizzes are offered, how many must you do, and by when?
fields.Back: 9 offered; complete 7 for full credit; each missing quiz counts as zero. All must be submitted by the last day of classes, NOT the exam day. Worth 10% total.

fields.Front: How is ES2240F structured, and who runs it?
fields.Back:
Part A (Units 1-3): terminology, concepts and processes. Part B (Unit 4): history of life-threatening catastrophes.
Instructor Dr. Sean Shieh (sshieh@uwo.ca); content developed by Prof. Neil D. MacRae. No textbook; all on OWL Brightspace. 18-25 pages of reading per week over 12 weeks, 13th week free for the report.

fields.Front: What are the ES2240F prerequisites/antirequisites and the AI policy?
fields.Back: Prerequisite: completion of first-year requirements. Antirequisites: Earth Sciences 240A/B, 241A/B, 2241A/B. Generative AI is not permitted on any assessment unless the instructor explicitly allows it; unauthorized electronic devices in an in-person assessment are a scholastic offence.

fields.Text: Report late penalties: {{c1::2%}} if submitted within two hours after the deadline, then {{c1::10%}} per late day for up to {{c1::5}} days (weekends included); after that {{c1::nothing}} is accepted.

The ES2240F final exam is worth {{c1::30%}}, is {{c1::non-cumulative}}, and covers the Unit 3 Introduction to Chapter {{c1::20}}; the midterm is worth {{c1::20%}} and covers Units 1-2 to the end of Chapter {{c1::9}}.
